what: Service Corporation International is North America's largest funeral and cemetery company, running about 1,500 funeral homes and 500 cemeteries, and it sells funerals and burial plots years in advance.
customers: Families arranging funerals, and people pre-purchasing their own arrangements.
money: funeral services, at need and pre-need
moat: Local funeral homes carry names families have used for generations, and cemetery land in cities is finite. Pre-need sales lock in business decades ahead.
risks: Cremation keeps taking share from burial, and cremations earn less per funeral
Death rates returned to normal after the pandemic years, which removed a revenue tailwind
opportunities: 17 times earnings and 13.8 times free cash flow with $681M of free cash flow
Analysts see about 33% upside, with 7 covering the stock
The pre-need backlog is worth billions and converts to revenue over coming decades as the population ages
watch: Pre-need sales production and the average revenue per funeral service.
